narrative.overview: Warm, grounded and reassuring. Held-light geometry, paper surfaces and restrained terracotta actions support the existing caregiver journey. Milestone 22 is implemented locally for builder review, not yet deployed. Later screen proposals remain future work.

rules.name: Colour is not a verdict
rules.body: Palette and fact icons never encode health as good or bad.

dos: Do preserve accessible back labels, focus and drafts.
Do preserve the 1,500-character Summary/share limit and complete details one click deeper.
donts: Don't present the prepared family illustration or later screen proposals as implemented.
Don't introduce clinical verdict colours, compulsory tours or family switching.
